item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Per-disk resiliency for Azure VMs
item.description:
Azure VMs now have a public preview option for per-disk resiliency. By default, Azure still recovers a VM by shutting it down and powering it back on after managed disk connectivity is restored.

  • Source: Azure Updates
